name: Marin County, CA
findings: Marin County has 1,689 nonprofit organizations. 680 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 546 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (12% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Marin County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Marin County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 43 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
